asciichat_error_t ui_input_render (frame_buffer_t *
  output, int row, int column, int width, int height, const char * text, size_t
  cursor, bool preserve_quotes)


Render a scrollable UTF-8 field with an active-row marker and
    visible cursor. Width excludes the two-cell marker. Quoted paths may retain
    their opening quote.
